title: North Sentinel Island analogy for hidden non-human observers

tellings.quote: And I've given the example of North Sentinel Island where India manages North Sentinel Island but doesn't land there. And in such a circumstance, there would be a fermy paradox among the natives of North Sentinel Island.

plain: India looks after North Sentinel Island, a small island in the Indian Ocean, but never lands there, so the people living on it would have no sign of the outside world that knows all about them. The mathematician Eric Weinstein offers this as his own comparison: the islanders would face their own Fermi paradox, the puzzle of why, if others are out there, we see no sign of them. He uses it to suggest that non-human beings could be watching Earth while choosing to stay away.
